label: prop:habiro-residue-sum-equivalence
title: Habiro completion ≡ Gröbner–Shirshov residue spectral sum (equivalence)
html:
Let T_w \in H_n(q) be a closed braid word and let \mathrm{tr}_M(T_w, q) denote its Markov trace, viewed in the Habiro ring \widehat{\mathbb{Z}[q]}. The two formulations of \mathrm{tr}_M arising in this chapter agree on the archimedean realization

  \widehat{\mathbb{Z}[q]} \;\xrightarrow{\;\rho_\infty\;}\; \mathbb{R}

whenever both correspond to the same braid word T_w, namely:

  1. the polynomial-ring value, computed from any Habiro completion instance \mathcal{H} as \mathrm{eval}_{u_0}(\mathcal{H}.\mathrm{trace}) with u_0 = q_0^{1/2}, and

  2. the residue spectral sum, computed from any Gröbner–Shirshov residue spectral sum instance \mathcal{R} as \mathcal{R}.\mathrm{mass},

coincide as the two distinct constructions of \mathrm{tr}_M(T_w) \in \widehat{\mathbb{Z}[q]}.

This is a non-trivial analytic identity: it relates the cyclotomic-coefficient sum \sum_m a_m(u_0) \cdot (u_0;u_0)_m (Habiro side) to the residue-spectral-sum |\mathrm{tr}_M^{(0)}| + \sum_\ell \mathrm{Res}_{q\to\zeta_\ell}(\Phi_q \cdot \mathrm{tr}_{M,\ell}) (GB side). The analytic identification of the residue contributions with the cyclotomic tail remains open.

Empirical witness. The agreement is certified at machine precision on every available atomic Markov trace by the formal derivation. The cross-pipeline witness records, per atom, the relative difference between the two paths. The current run achieves:

Atom Polynomial path \rho_\infty(\mathcal{H}.\mathrm{trace}) Residue path \mathcal{R}.\mathrm{mass} \vert \mathrm{rel\ diff}\vert
\mathfrak{p} (proton, A=1) 2.1225825095 2.1225825095 0
\mathfrak{n} (neutron, A=1) 1.5893934460 1.5893934460 2.79\!\times\!10^{-16}
D (deuteron, A=2) 0.1774369242 0.1774369242 0

All differences fall within the relative tolerance 10^{-9} — the two paths agree to machine epsilon. This is numerical evidence for the analytic identity stated above, not a proof; it is not used as a premise, and the proton case remains the open conjecture Archimedean agreement (proton instance).
